about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for adh (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Diagram 4 is printed beside paragraph 1.22 under Branch discharge pipes, but the tree puts it after 1.30 under Discharge stacks.
findings.evidence: tree: "Section 1: Sanitary pipework > Discharge stacks > Branch ventilation pipes"

findings.problem: Diagrams 5 and 6 belong to paragraphs 1.30 and 1.31 under Discharge stacks, but the tree puts them under Materials for pipes, fittings and joints.
findings.evidence: tree: "Materials for pipes, fittings and joints > Stub stack" / "... > Termination of ventilation stacks or ventilation part of discharge"

findings.problem: The notes of Table 7 are attached to Table 6's text and are missing from Table 7, so the meaning of the '+' marks and the trade effluent warning are lost there.
findings.evidence: source (Table 7): "+ Application area code UD should normally be specified" "Note: Some of these materials may not be suitable for conveying trade effluent" / tree Table 7 text: "Material British Standard Rigid pipes"

findings.problem: Table 6's text mixes in rows of Table 7 from the other column.
findings.evidence: tree: "(litres/sec) (mm) gradient capacity Concrete BS 5911", "100 1:40 9.2 Ductile iron BS EN 598"

findings.problem: Diagrams 11 and 12 are printed above the 'Clearance of blockages' heading (they belong to bedding and backfilling, paras 2.44-2.45) but the tree puts them under 'Clearance of blockages' and after Table 11.
findings.evidence: tree: "Section 2: Foul drainage > Clearance of blockages > Protection for pipes laid at shallow depths (minimum sizes)"

findings.problem: Footnote markers printed on Table 12 cells are dropped from the grid, so cells lose their link to notes 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 (notes themselves are kept in text).
A.3 (left column, under Capacity of pipes) is merged into the Traps text after A.4, so it sits under the wrong heading and in the wrong order.
findings.evidence: tree: "(see paragraph 1.4) A.4 Minimum trap sizes ... A.3 Flow rates for other commonly used appliances"

findings.problem: Table A2 belongs to the left column under Capacity of pipes but is placed under the Traps heading.
findings.evidence: tree: "Appendix H1-A: Additional guidance for larger buildings > Traps > Flow rates from appliances"

findings.problem: A stray text block under Traps repeats rows of Table A1 with no context.
Table A3 title is cut short, losing the words that limit its scope.
findings.evidence: source: "Minimum trap sizes and seal depths additional to Table 2" / tree: "Minimum trap sizes and seal"

findings.problem: Table A1 text mixes in Table A3 rows and lacks most of its own rows; Table A3 text is truncated (grids are correct).
findings.evidence: tree: "(industrial type) 50 75", "Number of Flow rate Urinal stall", "dwellings (litres/sec) (1 to 6 person position) 65 50"

findings.problem: Paragraph 1.17 on septic tank siting is given as ending on this page, but none of its text is printed here.
findings.evidence: tree: "Where they are to be emptied using a tanker, the septic tank should be sited within 30m of a vehicle access"

findings.problem: The superscript in the trial hole area unit is lost.
findings.evidence: source: "1m² in area" / tree: "1m2 in area"

findings.problem: Diagram 1 has no labels; the printed words appear only in the description.
findings.evidence: source: "Minimum 2m separation", "Graded 30–50mm granular material"

findings.problem: The note printed under Table 2 is attached to Table 1's text, and Table 2's text has no note.
findings.evidence: source (under Table 2): "Note: Refers to nominal half round eaves gutters laid level with outlets at one end sharp edged" / tree: in Table 1 text

findings.problem: Table 1's text includes Table 2's data rows mixed in with its own rows.
findings.evidence: tree: "1 Flat roof plan area of relevant portion 53.0 115 63 1.11"

findings.problem: The closing sentence of 0.1, printed after the list, is joined into item b.
findings.evidence: tree: "b. which are yards ... by more than one building. The provisions of H3 only apply if these surfaces are paved."

findings.problem: The superscript in the Table 2 unit is lost.
findings.evidence: source: "(m²)" / tree: "(m2)"

findings.problem: A word from the table ('Food') is run into the text of paragraph 1.2.
findings.evidence: source: "major flush volumes as low as 4 litres" / tree: "major flush volumesFood as low as 4 litres"

findings.problem: Diagram 1 has no labels; the printed words appear only in the description.
findings.evidence: source: "Floor level", "1.3m max.", "Invert of drain"
